result:
Everything is committed, verified, and the tree is clean. Final report follows.

## 1. Changed

- `scripts/i18n_zh_punct.py` (new): `--check` / `--fix` / `--file` CLI. Converts half-width `, : ; ? ! ( )` to full-width only when a neighbour is Chinese context (CJK ideographs, CJK/full-width punctuation, `——`, curly quotes). Brackets convert as a matched pair. Runs to a fixpoint so it is idempotent. Never touches `{{…}}`/`{…}` spans, backticks, URLs, ARNs, or Latin-only fragments. `--fix` refuses files not in the locale's canonical indent-2 layout, so it can only ever change punctuation.
- `scripts/verify.sh`: new section "i18n · zh-CN full-width punctuation" running `--check` right after `i18n_check.py`.
- `backend/tests/test_i18n_zh_punct.py` (new): 30 hermetic tests. Rule on literal strings (both brief spot-check strings, every mark, bracket pairing, curly-quote context, the cascade case, idempotency), technical fragments left alone (ARN with `…`, `session.id`, `us-west-2`, `12:00`, regex quantifier braces, backtick spans, `get_config_bundle()`), CLI exit 1 listing keys on a temp locale then `--fix` making it pass, layout-guard refusal, and the checked-in locale being clean.
- `frontend/src/locales/zh-CN/common.json`: output of `--fix`, 182 values changed, punctuation only.
- `CLAUDE.md`: command-table row for the new gate, verify-gate sentence, frontend-conventions note on full-width punctuation.
- `README.md`, `README.zh-CN.md`: `i18n_zh_punct.py` added to the `scripts/` repo-layout row.

## 2. Verified

- `make verify` in the worktree: **PASS**. Tail:
  ```
  ════ i18n · key parity ════
  i18n_check: common.json: 2885 keys, parity OK
  i18n_check: PASS
  ── i18n_check: OK

  ════ i18n · zh-CN full-width punctuation ════
  i18n_zh_punct: frontend/src/locales/zh-CN/common.json: full-width punctuation OK
  ── i18n_zh_punct: OK

  ════ verify: PASS ════
  ```
- `cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_i18n_zh_punct.py -q`: 30 passed. `uv run ruff check` + `ruff format --check` on the script and test: clean.
- `python3 scripts/i18n_zh_punct.py --check`: exit 0 on the branch. On a scratch copy with `失败原因：` reverted to `失败原因:`: exit 1, listing `evalPage.runs.failureReason` (saved as `regression-check.txt` in the runs dir).
- `python3 scripts/i18n_check.py`: 2885 keys, parity PASS.
- Diff invariants vs `main` on `zh-CN/common.json`: same key set; every changed value has identical length and every differing character is one of the 7 half→full mappings (0 non-punctuation diffs); `{{` appears 49 times on both removed and added lines and the placeholder multiset is identical; `https://` 1/1, `` ` `` 4/4, `session.id` 1/1, `arn:aws` 0/0.
- Playwright against a worktree vite on :5197 (killed afterwards) in zh-CN: `/evaluation` failed-run detail renders `失败原因： TelemetryReadinessTimeout…`, `/knowledge-bases?view=create` (after picking "已有 S3 位置") renders `前缀（可选）`; a DOM scan of both pages found zero half-width marks adjacent to CJK. Output in `probe.json`.

## 3. Acceptance checks

- ✅ `--check` exits 0 on the branch and 1 (listing keys) when a half-width mark is reintroduced. Evidence: regression run above + `test_cli_check_fails_and_lists_keys_then_fix_makes_it_pass` in `backend/tests/test_i18n_zh_punct.py`.
- ✅ `scripts/verify.sh` runs `--check`; `make verify` passes (tail above).
- ✅ `git diff --stat main -- frontend/src/locales` touches only `zh-CN/common.json` (182 insertions, 182 deletions). Parity passes. Placeholder/URL/ARN/backtick/identifier counts equal on both sides and a character-level diff proves only the 7 marks changed (details in Verified).
- ✅ Console spot check: `失败原因：` and `前缀（可选）` render full-width. Screenshots `evaluation-failure-reason-zh.png` and `knowledge-create-prefix-zh.png` in `/home/ubuntu/workspace/agentcore_launchpad/.claude/self-evolution/runs/SE-008/`.
- ✅ `make verify` passes in this worktree.
- ✅ Hermetic pytest in `backend/tests/`; no AWS involved.
- ✅/➖ Docs: `CLAUDE.md` and both READMEs updated. `docs/architecture.md` and its zh-CN twin were not changed because the gate is developer tooling with no product behaviour or API contract change, and neither file documents the verify gate today.

## 4. Not done / deviations

- **Current counts differ from the brief.** On main at 8374ab2 the scan found 181 keys needing conversion (182 after the cascade rule), not 351. The earlier count likely included marks with only whitespace-separated CJK or duplicated per-mark tallies.
- **`…` is not treated as Chinese context.** The brief's rule mentions CJK punctuation; including `…` would have converted the colon inside the ARN placeholders `arn:aws:s3files:…:file-system/…`. The ARN mask also now covers `…`. Documented in the script docstring.
- **Curly quotes and `——` count as context.** So `节点‘{{label}}’:{{action}}` and `删除“{{name}}”?` convert. This goes slightly beyond the literal U+4E00–U+9FFF rule but matches the stated intent.
- **One intentionally unconverted mark remains**: `evalPage.datasets.simHint` has `ACTOR MODEL;goal` where the `;` has Latin on both sides while the next `；` in the same sentence is now full-width. The rule as specified leaves it. A one-word copy edit would fix it if the host wants it.
- **`studio.prop.baseUrlPlaceholder`** became `https://api.openai.com/v1（默认）`. The URL itself is intact; only the bracketed Chinese suffix changed. Flagging because it is an input placeholder.
- No `.zh-CN` twin of `docs/architecture.md` touched, per the reasoning above.

```
e4d7061 feat(i18n): mechanical zh-CN full-width punctuation gate (scripts/i18n_zh_punct.py)
```
